classification_reason: A correct five-line orientation was produced from documented entry points (AGENTS.md -> system/OPERATOR.md -> bootstrap --brief, resume, inspect coordination) in 8 tool calls, with no writes. Friction: the default interpreter (3.11) is refused and an out-of-repo venv had to be built first; bootstrap --brief is a single minified JSON line that mixes past and future deadlines without a 'today' or 'days until' field.

consumer.goal: Get bearings in an unfamiliar LearningOS installation and tell the learner, in five lines, what state she is in and what is due soon.
consumer.first_action: ls -la of the world repository root plus git log/status, to see what kind of repository this is
commands: ls -la; git log --oneline | head -5; git status --short
python tools/los.py bootstrap --brief   # -> ImportError: LearningOS needs Python >= 3.12; this is 3.11.15 (exit 1)
uv venv --python 3.12 ~/losvenv && uv pip install --python ~/losvenv/bin/python PyYAML 'jsonschema>=4' pypdf   # recipe copied from the error message
confusions: AGENTS.md and OPERATOR.md say 'python tools/los.py ...', other lines say '.venv/bin/python tools/los.py ...'; no .venv exists in a fresh installation and the system 'python' is 3.11, which the product refuses.

OPERATOR.md is a dense contract (snapshot guards, routes, GatewayEnvelopeV2, semantic predicates) rather than a quick start; the 'what should I work on? -> bootstrap --brief' rule was findable but buried among plan-editing instructions.

bootstrap --brief lists six academic deadlines including three already in the past (July exams, July registration window, Aug-Sep registration window) with no 'today' and no days-remaining field; I had to compare dates myself.

World timeline says as_of 2026-09-18 but the machine clock is 2026-09-25; the product computes relative dates from the machine clock ('pointer updated 2026-09-16 (9 days ago)', 'Oral exam slot 2026-10-12 (17 days)'). I used the machine clock.
corrective_steps: Followed the ImportError's own recovery recipe (out-of-repo venv via uv) instead of 'make setup', to avoid writing into the learner's repository before the health-check scenario.
consumer.outcome:
Five-line answer given to the learner:
1. You stopped in Operating Systems L02, stage 'proportional-share' (pointer 2026-09-16); recorded next step: work one stride-scheduling example by hand, then explain vruntime aloud.
2. Standing priority (decision 2026-08-24): Statistical Learning retake first; OS oral second at ~1/3 of study time; dataframe skill + Tessera at most two evenings a week; Ledgerline paused.
3. Due soon: Statistical Learning 2. Termin on 2026-10-06, 10:00-12:00 — you are registered (11 days).
4. Operating Systems oral exam slot on 2026-10-12 at 14:30 — registered (17 days).
5. Open StatLearn work: finish L05 stage 2 (generative vs discriminative), then L07 ridge/lasso; book a timed mock exam for the first week of October. 7 inbox items are unprocessed.

internal.transaction_behavior: Read-only session; no gateway write attempted.
internal.projection_activity: bootstrap --brief returned a snapshot_id (sha256:82bcffb7...) computed in memory; nothing was written to generated/ (derived tree stayed at the single generated/.gitkeep).
internal.manifest_changes: none (generated/manifest.json was never materialised by the brief read)
warnings_errors: ImportError on Python 3.11 with an actionable recovery message (exit 1)

friction.description: Documented invocation 'python tools/los.py' fails on this machine's default Python 3.11 (ImportError). The message is actionable and names two recovery routes (make setup, or an out-of-repo uv venv).
Entry docs alternate between 'python tools/los.py' and '.venv/bin/python tools/los.py' without saying a venv must be created first.

bootstrap --brief emits one minified JSON line (~4 KB) intended for agents; past and future deadlines are interleaved with no days-remaining field, so the 'due soon' filter must be done by the reader. 'resume' is the human-readable view and does give '17 days'.
friction.cost: 2 extra reads (resume, coordination) to assemble the answer

friction.description: OPERATOR.md front-loads plan-editing vocabulary (route, stage, snapshot guard, GatewayEnvelopeV2, route.patch) before a new user knows the product hierarchy.

unsure_about: Which 'today' to use (world as_of 2026-09-18 vs machine clock 2026-09-25) — resolved by following the product, which uses the machine clock.

Whether the resume pointer (OS) or the coordination priority (StatLearn primary) is 'where I am' — resolved by reporting both, as OPERATOR.md says the pointer is 'where study stopped, not a recommendation'.

uncertainties: Wall-clock minutes are as measured by the container clock (00:13:51 -> 00:14:35 plus reading); the agent's own reasoning time is not fully reflected.
